name: zsnd_cd_set_volume
description: zSndCd::SetVolume writes AUX volume when CD audio is ready, using a mono average when stereo AUX is unavailable and packed left/right channels when it is available.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the coherent zSndCd source-file cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4a2880 returns zero when the CD-ready flag is clear, calls IsStereoAuxEnabled, sends either the signed average of primary and secondary or secondary<<16|primary to auxSetVolume, reports line 0x1b2 on AUX failure, and caches the original primary/secondary values only after success.

Native smoke zsnd_cd_set_volume_smoke patches auxSetVolume and verifies the not-ready guard, mono average, stereo packed channel value, cached globals, AUX device argument, and AUX failure return path.
